entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi Sarah. I'm calling about my VeloBand Pulse. It's just not working correctly and I'd like to see about a return.
I'm sorry to hear you're having trouble with it. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference matter?
It's a technical fault. The band simply won't sync with the app anymore. I've tried restarting my phone, reinstalling the app, everything. I think the Bluetooth connection is broken.
Okay, I see. A device that won't sync is definitely a problem. Let me pull up your account details. Can I get the email address associated with your VeloFit account?
Thank you, Alex. I see your order here. It looks like the VeloBand Pulse was delivered on December 15th, so about 31 days ago. And you're saying the item is defective?

Yes, that's right. It worked for a couple of weeks and now it's useless. Look, I know I'm just over a month in, so I might be past the standard return period. Could we negotiate something? Maybe a partial credit? I'd be happy with that.
I appreciate you being flexible. Let me just pull up our official return policy here to see what the options are... one moment please.
Okay, I've got it. Actually, you're in luck. Our policy states that items are eligible for a return within 90 days of delivery.
Oh, 90 days? I was expecting something much shorter. That's fantastic news.

Yes, since you're only on day 31, you're well within that timeframe. Since you're reporting the item as defective, I can go ahead and authorize a full refund. I'm generating a prepaid shipping label to send to your email right now.
A full refund is perfect. That completely solves my problem. Thank you so much for looking that up for me.
Of course! I'm happy I could get this sorted out for you. The email with the label should be in your inbox shortly. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's all. You've been a great help, Sarah.
You're very welcome, Alex. Thanks for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
